text:
noah: Quick note 1: thinking about POSTMORTEM follow-ups - propose two small changes: (A) standard timeline template for remediations (B) IC rotation tweak to avoid weekend blindspots. Short thread.

rita: Love it. Can you sketch the timeline template? want something we can paste into the tracker and automate reminders for.

noah: Minimal timeline template below. Goal: keep it 1 screen and machine-actionable.

```
Remediation Timeline Template
- remediation-id: R-<YYMM>-NN
- severity: P1/P2/P3
- owner: <team/person>
- fallback: <team/person>
- escalator: <role>
- assigned-date: YYYY-MM-DD
- due-date: YYYY-MM-DD (default +90d for P2/P3, +30d for P1)
- reminder-cadence: 14d/7d/2d before due
- status: open/in-progress/blocked/done
- regression-risk: low/med/high
- handoff-latency-hours: <auto populated>
- notes: short free text
```

omar: Nice. Add a small 'recurrence-flag' checkbox when an incident matches a historical pattern so we can tag repeat modes.

tia: Also track first-owner-ack timestamp so we can measure handoff latency. If ack > 24h, incident-bot should create a 'handoff-lag' alert to the oncall lead.

michael: On IC rotation: instead of adding weekend rotations, propose a 'soft standby' role. Soft standby = named person reachable, but only paged after an automated checklist & primary triage. Rotate standby every quarter to reduce churn.

sana: For pilot, I'd prefer quarterly rotation but allow opt-out for personal reasons. Also capture 'standby-coverage' in the calendar entry with clear escalation path.

incident-bot: Watcher created: remediation-timeline-template-v1. Automation available: owner DM at 14/2 days before due, weekly digest to #eng-oncall, flag overdue items. To enable, add Confluence template URL to pilot config. :robot_face:

rita: Pilot plan: start with infra + platform teams for 6 weeks. Measure: % overdue, median handoff-latency, number of repeat-mode tags. If handoff-latency drops and overdue % < baseline, expand.

noah: Action items: noah: add template to tracker & Confluence; incident-bot: enable pings once URL added; tia: add ack timestamp hook; sana: draft soft-standby calendar entries + quarterly rotation doc; omar: add recurrence-tagging logic to tracker. Reconvene in #eng-oncall next Thurs to sign off on pilot kickoff. :white_check_mark:
